title: test_aead: TAG_LEN hardcoded, v4 12-byte tag breaks test
description: tests/kernel/test_aead.c defines TAG_LEN=16 and uses it unconditionally for crypto_aead_setauthsize, tag comparison (line 126), and decrypt setup (line 140). The new v4 vector has tag_len=12. When run_gcm_vector processes v4: (1) encrypt compares 16 bytes against the 12-byte v->tag array (4-byte over-read + guaranteed T_FAIL); (2) decrypt copies 16 bytes from the 12-byte v->tag array into src_buf (4-byte over-read), then passes inlen+16 to aead_request_set_crypt, causing EBADMSG because the appended garbage bytes form an invalid tag. Fix: replace TAG_LEN with v->tag_len in run_gcm_vector, including setauthsize, buf_len allocation, tag comparison, decrypt tag copy, and aead_request_set_crypt crypt length.
